milestone: dsh-vertical-kit publishes /checks.json — the twenty checks as data
why: every other surface on the kit is for a person: the pages explain a check, the compare table helps a visitor pick one. An agent or a script that wants to know what exists has to parse HTML. A programming audience for a plugin ecosystem expects the set as data.
generated_from: scripts/checks-data.mjs — the same source as the pages, the compare table and llms.txt, so the four cannot disagree
validation: a script checked that no field is empty across all twenty entries, that every route matches POST /<slug>/api, and that every page URL is absolute
discovery: site build reports 22 pages plus the manifest
honest_note: a manifest does not make an ecosystem. It makes the set legible to the tools that would otherwise have to scrape — which is the cheapest thing that was still missing.
